title: geosciml4china: self-supporting semantic calibration and GeoSciML 4.1 interoperability for China's 1:250,000 geological map sheets
description: geosciml4china turns a legacy MapGIS 6.x/67 project folder into trustworthy, confidence-graded geological semantics: MapGIS → L0 GeoJSON → self-supporting semantic calibration (nine domains, code-level codebook + confidence statistics) → GeoSciML 4.1 (fully decoupled from the MapGIS code system) → GeoSciML-semantics-driven rendering (DZ/T 0179-2025). Attribute-code semantics are recovered from the map's own geometry, topology and graphic parameters when the code dictionary is unavailable; contradictions are registered for expert adjudication and the original encoding is never rewritten.
